function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### What “best” really means When people ask for the *best* men’s underwear, they’re usually looking at three core criteria: | Criterion | Why it matters | |-----------|----------------| | **Comfort & Fit** | You’ll wear it all day – if it digs into skin or feels too tight, you won’t enjoy it. | | **Support & Functionality** | For active use or daily work, proper support keeps everything where it belongs without chafing. | | **Durability / Material Quality** | Good fabric lasts longer, stays soft after washes, and doesn’t lose shape quickly. | Below we break down each major style, highlight what makes them great (or not), and suggest when to pick one over another. --- ## 1️⃣ Briefs > Classic cut; high waist, snug front panel, no leg coverage beyond the hips. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Excellent support for activewear or gym sessions.
• Keeps everything in place during vigorous movement.
• Great under fitted pants because there’s no bulk. | • Can feel restrictive around thighs if too tight.
• Not ideal for very loose-fitting trousers—may create visible lines. | | **Top Brands:** Calvin Klein, Hanes, Jockey, Under Armour
**Material Tips:** Look for breathable cotton blends or performance fibers (e.g., polyester‑spandex) that wick sweat. | **Ideal Use:** Sports, running, office days with tailored slacks. --- ## 2️⃣ Boxers > Loose, long‑legged, low‑waist design; minimal compression. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Maximum airflow; perfect for hot climates.
• Minimal pressure points → good for sleeping or lounging.
• Wide variety of prints & patterns. | • Lack of support may cause discomfort during intense activity.
• Tends to bunch up inside jeans or cargo pants. | | **Top Brands:** Fruit of the Loom, Tommy John, Mack Weldon, Lululemon (for premium stretch)
**Material Tips:** Organic cotton, bamboo, modal, or lightweight linen for breathability. | **Ideal Use:** Casual wear, sleepwear, relaxed weekends. --- ## 3️⃣ Boxer Briefs (Boxer‑Brief Hybrid) > Combines the length of boxers with the supportive waistband of briefs. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Best of both worlds: full coverage + firm support.
• Reduces friction against clothing, preventing bulges.
• Versatile enough for most body types. | • Some find them still slightly bulky under certain cuts.
• If poorly sized, can pinch the groin area. | | **Top Brands:** SAXX, MeUndies, Calvin Klein, Nike, Adidas
**Material Tips:** Moisture‑wicking microfiber blends, spandex for elasticity, seamless construction reduces seams. | **Ideal Use:** Everyday wear, travel, moderate exercise. --- ## 4️⃣ Trunks (Short‑Leg Boxer Briefs) > Shorter than traditional boxer briefs; mid‑rise waistband. | Pros | Cons | |------|------| | • Sleek profile fits well under slim or athletic cuts.
• Less bulk while maintaining support.
• Often have reinforced stitching for longevity. | • May expose more thigh area compared to longer briefs.
• Limited availability in larger sizes from some manufacturers. | | **Top Brands:** H&M, Uniqlo, ASOS, Gildan, Champion
**Material Tips:** Stretchy nylon/spandex mixes, anti‑odor treatments for extended wear. | **Ideal Use:** Modern fashion, skinny jeans, joggers, light workouts. --- ## 5️⃣ Performance / Athletic Undergarments These are engineered specifically for sports, featuring advanced tech: | Feature | Benefit | |---------|--------| | **Moisture‑wicking** | Pulls sweat away from skin, keeping dry.
**Examples:** Dri‑Fit, Coolmax. | | **Anti‑chafe lining** | Prevents irritation during long runs.
**Example:** Seamless mesh panels. | | **Compression zones** | Supports muscles, improves circulation.
**Brands:** Under Armour HeatGear, Nike Pro. | **Where to Buy:** Sporting goods stores, dedicated athleisure retailers, online marketplaces. --- ## 6️⃣ Specialty Styles | Style | When It Shines | |-------|---------------| | **Thermal / Wool Blend** | Cold climates; offers insulation without overheating. | | **Eco‑Friendly Fabrics** | Bamboo, hemp, recycled polyester for sustainability-conscious shoppers. | | **Luxury Materials** | Silk, cashmere blends for upscale occasions or gifting. | | **Medical Support** | Extra‑wide waistband, ergonomic pouch for specific health needs. | --- ## Quick Size Guide Cheat Sheet | Body Type | Suggested Waist Range | Leg Length Preference | |------------|---------------------|-----------------------| | Slim | Small–Medium | Medium | | Average | Medium | Long | | Large | Large | Long | | Very Tall | XL+ | Extra Long | *(Always check individual brand size charts—they vary.)* --- ## Final Takeaway There isn’t a single “one-size-fits-all” best underwear—it depends on your lifestyle, climate, and personal preference. However, here’s a quick rule of thumb: | Situation | Recommended Style | |----------|-------------------| | Daily office, tailored suits | Briefs or Boxer Briefs | | Hot summer nights | Light Cotton Boxers | | Intense workout | Performance Shorts or Compression Pouch | | Travel & versatility | Premium Boxer Briefs (SAXX, MeUndies) | | Fashion-forward look | Trunks or Designer Boxers | If you’re unsure, try mixing two styles: e.g., a pair of comfortable cotton boxers for home/lounging plus a durable boxer brief for workdays. Over time you’ll discover which combination gives you the best blend of comfort, support, and confidence. Happy shopping!
